name: youtube
description: Inspect and retrieve authorized YouTube media through a bounded yt-dlp workflow with protected browser-exported cookies.

interface.longDescription: Inspect YouTube metadata, retrieve authorized video, audio, subtitles, thumbnails, chapters, and bounded playlist or channel archives through yt-dlp. Account-gated access uses a browser-exported, YouTube-only Netscape cookie file installed in protected local storage; cookie values never enter chat or evidence.
defaultPrompt: Inspect this YouTube URL without downloading media.
Download this authorized video with subtitles and metadata.
Sync new authorized items from this YouTube playlist.
